name: Capital Area Food Bank Distribution Center Volunteering

offerings.summary: Volunteers sort and pack food at the food bank's DC distribution centre on scheduled morning or afternoon shifts.

loc.venue: Capital Area Food Bank distribution center

age.raw: The minimum requirement to volunteer in our distribution center is 12 years of age

other: Have a waiver signed by a parent or guardian
Be accompanied and actively supervised by an adult
1 adult chaperone for every 10 volunteers age 18 or under

sched.schedule_raw: Morning shifts begin at 8:45 a.m.; afternoon shifts begin at 12:45 p.m.

reqs.raw: Have a waiver signed by a parent or guardian

issues: Under-18 volunteers must be accompanied by an adult, which limits solo participation; students should check before signing up alone
